=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1505-1531 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fallback loop in `_mt_dispatch_rb_judge` (`for mt_rbj_wf in ai-review.yml internal-review.yml`) dispatches with `-f force_rb_judge=true` but without `-f allow_workflow_edits=false`. `.github/workflows/internal-review.yml` declares that input with `default: true` (lines 22-26) and forwards it at line 66, so a judge-only run gets workflow-edit capability, although the function header at lines 1505-1506 says "allow_workflow_edits left at its default (false)".
  WHY: When the `review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml` and `ai-review.yml` dispatches fail, the judge-only fix/terminal-fix path runs with `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=true` and can commit changes under `.github/workflows/`. The dedicated judge wrapper (`review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml` lines 17-19) explicitly forbids this. All reviewers rated it MAJOR, mapped here to high. minimax_minimax-m3 reported it twice, once under correctness and once under trust boundary.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3353-3363 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the waiter branch of `_merge_lease_pr_eligible`, the pattern `""|"pending "*` accepts a pending head-gate from any login, including `pending someone-else` and `pending ` with an empty creator. The inline comment (lines 3354-3355), `agents.d/9987-judge-decision-lease-grant.md` and the README `MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED` row all say a head-gate from another login keeps `no_head_gate`.
  WHY: A waiter with a foreign pending head-gate and a trusted `ai-review/judge-merge-pending` success is granted with `gate=judge_decision` instead of being skipped with `no_head_gate`. No test covers this case. The judge's gates still apply, so this is contract drift and not an unsafe merge. All reviewers rated it NIT, mapped here to low.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1531-1533 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: If the dedicated judge workflow and both `force_rb_judge=true` wrappers fail to dispatch, `_mt_dispatch_rb_judge` falls back to `_mt_dispatch_review`, which dispatches without `force_rb_judge=true`.
  WHY: A `gate=judge_decision` grant then starts a plain review round. That round can end `ai:review-blocked` again and wait for stall recovery, which is the cycle G3 forbids, and the test `test_no_judge_wrapper_falls_back_to_one_plain_review_dispatch` codifies it. Reviewers disagreed on severity: openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said MAJOR, minimax_minimax-m3 said NIT, and the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly did not count this fallback as a G3 gap.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_merge_lease_pr_eligible`, the waiter branch, lines 3353-3363: `case "${elig_gate}" in ""|"pending "*) ;; *) MERGE_LEASE_INELIGIBLE_REASON="no_head_gate"; return 1 ;; esac` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `"pending "*` accepts a pending head-gate from any creator. The inline comment at lines 3354-3355, the agents.d fragment and the README `MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED` row all say a head-gate from another login keeps `no_head_gate`.
  WHY: A foreign pending head-gate plus `ai-review/judge-merge-pending` success is granted with `gate=judge_decision`, while a foreign success/failure/error is skipped, and no test covers this. This is contract drift, not an unsafe merge. Fix by changing the arm to `""|"pending ${elig_login}") ;;` and adding a test to `tests/test_merge_lease.py`, or by rewording the docs.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:`_mt_dispatch_rb_judge`, lines 1505-1506 (header says "allow_workflow_edits left at its default (false)") and lines 1524-1527 (`# allow_workflow_edits stays at each wrapper's default, as above.`, then `gh_retry gh workflow run "${mt_rbj_wf}" ... -f pr_number="${mt_rbj_pr}" -f force_rb_judge=true`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback dispatches `internal-review.yml` without `allow_workflow_edits`. That input has `default: true` (lines 22-26) and is forwarded at line 66 to `review_autofix.yml`. `.github/workflows/ai-review.yml` does not exist in the source repo, so a failed `review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml` dispatch falls through to `internal-review.yml`.
  WHY: The judge-only fix path runs with workflow-edit capability, which `.github/workflows/review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml` lines 17-19 forbid. This affects the source repo and consumers that copied `internal-review.yml`. Fix by adding `-f allow_workflow_edits=false` and updating the exact-argv assertions in `tests/test_review_merge_train.py` and `tests/test_merge_lease.py`.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. G1-G6 are all present. The last-resort `_mt_dispatch_review` fallback (`review_merge_train.sh` line 1533) is documented and not counted as a G3 gap.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS:
  - Append `-f allow_workflow_edits=false` at `_mt_dispatch_rb_judge` fallback loop, line 1527.
  - Change `_merge_lease_pr_eligible`, line 3358 to `""|"pending ${elig_login}") ;;`.
  - HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3

  WHY: A consumer that lacks all three wrappers gets a fresh review round that can re-enter the blocked state. `_mt_dispatch_review` also defaults `MERGE_TRAIN_ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=true` (line 1475).
